episode_title: Grok Bot: The 24/7 Cloud Computer That Replaces You
topic_overview: xAI's Grok Bot introduces persistent cloud computers that run autonomously 24/7, using 'Teach-a-Task' screen recordings and real-time X data to execute complex human workflows.

hook_strategy.archetype: The Trinity Hybrid Nuke (Brown x Kallaway x Ramonov)
hook_strategy.spoken_words: Elon Musk just quietly ended traditional AI chatbots... but you're looking at the wrong feature. It's not Grok 4. It's Grok Bot.
hook_strategy.visual_action: 0.0s: Pitch black screen shattered by bright electric white glitch text. 0.8s: Camera crashes into a glowing server rack showing a dedicated virtual desktop spinning by itself. 1.8s: Split screen contrasting ChatGPT chat input with an autonomous mouse moving on an unattended desktop.

mode_a_standalone_script: Elon Musk just quietly ended traditional AI chatbots... but you're looking at the wrong feature. It's not Grok 4. It's Grok Bot. Traditional AI is passive—you ask a question, it writes text, then it dies. But Grok Bot is an autonomous cloud computer running 24/7. Watch this: with 'Teach-a-Task', you record your screen once doing your job—scraping leads, filing invoices, or debugging code. Grok Bot memorizes your exact mouse movements and executes it infinitely in the background while your laptop is closed. Backed by Colossus, the largest GPU cluster on Earth, and real-time live data from X, this isn't a chatbot. It's an autonomous digital employee. Save this video right now, because the 'Teach-a-Task' blueprint is the exact skill you need to survive 2026.
mode_b_on_camera_script: [LEAN INTO CAMERA] Elon Musk just quietly ended traditional AI chatbots... [PUNCH-IN ZOOM] but you're looking at the wrong feature. It's not Grok 4. It's Grok Bot. [POINT LEFT AT FLOATING UI] See, ChatGPT is passive—you chat, it answers, then stops. [WIDE SHOT] But Grok Bot is a dedicated virtual computer running in the cloud 24/7. [LOOK AT SCREEN / PICTURE-IN-PICTURE] With 'Teach-a-Task', you record your workflow once—sales outreach, invoice processing, bug testing. [SNAP FINGERS] Close your laptop. It keeps working all night. Powered by xAI's Colossus cluster and real-time X telemetry, this isn't a conversational toy. It's an autonomous operator. [DIRECT EYE CONTACT] Save this video—because learning to delegate to autonomous cloud bots is the only AI skill that matters this year.

bookmark_takeaway.step_1: Record: Use Teach-a-Task to record one manual 5-minute repetitive workflow.
bookmark_takeaway.step_2: Virtualize: Assign the recording to a persistent cloud computer instance in Grok.
bookmark_takeaway.step_3: Trigger: Connect real-time X alerts or email webhooks to trigger execution 24/7.

zero_dollar_feasibility: 100% executable with Gemini, Antigravity built-in image generator for visual metaphors, free Chrome browser screen recording (OBS or native Windows Win+Alt+R), and free CapCut or Premiere editing.
